name: delivery-loop
description: Run unattended issue-to-merge delivery or continue a long-horizon repository objective without Codex Goal mode. Uses isolated worktrees, touch-scope leases, computed reviews, gated auto-merge, durable checkpoints, and bounded dead-loop recovery without sub-agents.

interface.longDescription: Run unattended issue-to-merge delivery or continue a long-horizon repository objective without Codex Goal mode. Uses isolated worktrees, touch-scope leases, computed reviews, gated auto-merge, durable checkpoints, and bounded dead-loop recovery without sub-agents. Modes: delivery-loop/init, delivery-loop/plan, delivery-loop/work, delivery-loop/review, delivery-loop/ship, delivery-loop/recover, delivery-loop/goal.
